facts.fact: Elon Musk and Starlink's official X accounts announced on 2026-08-29 that Starlink service is now available in Equatorial Guinea, shown as available on the company coverage map (company announcement as reported by Revista Real EG).

In July 2026 the government temporarily authorised US offshore oil companies to use Starlink, by a document signed by the Minister of State for Transport, Telecommunications and Civil Aviation (offshore corporate use, temporary authorisation).
